units: <cite ref="Ketubot 75a:9">Keth. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>אפשר דנקיט פ׳ וכ׳</he> he may take a grain (or a bit) of pepper in his mouth (to dispel the bad smell) and perform his priestly function.

<cite ref="Megillah 7a:18">Meg. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>חדא פ׳ חריפתא</he> one grain of sharp pepper, v. <cite ref="H01686"><he>חָרִיף</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="Q01119"><he>פִּלְפְּלִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01118"><he>פִּלְפְּלֵי</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01111"><he>פִּילְ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 141a:7">Sabb. 141ᵃ</cite> <he>הני פ׳ וכ׳</he> (Ar. <cite ref="Q01960"><he>פרפלי</he></cite>) grains of pepper one may crush singly (on the Sabbath).
<cite ref="Yoma 81b:5">Yoma 81ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>כס פ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="K00950"><he>כְּסַס</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 42b">Pes. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>פי׳ אֲרִיכָתָא</he> (Ms. M. <he>פילפלא אריכְתָּא</he>) long pepper; <cite ref="Gittin 69b:7">Gitt. 69ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
